purpose: Freeze pre-existing company baselines available before the early weekly Q1 decisions. No post-cutoff outcome prices are included.

documents.title: 兆易创新2025年第三季度报告
normalizedClaims: Q3 revenue RMB2.681bn, +31.40% YoY; Q3 attributable profit RMB507.8m, +61.13%; Q3 ex-item profit +63.71%.
2025前三季度 revenue +20.92%, attributable profit +30.18%, ex-item profit +34.04%.
Operating cash flow for the first three quarters was RMB1.796bn, -3.30% YoY.

documents.publisher: 华创证券 via 新浪财经
documents.title: 兆易创新2025年三季报点评：存储价格持续改善 定制化存储先发优势显著
normalizedClaims: The contemporaneous report linked Q3 acceleration to improving DRAM supply/demand and described revenue/profit and gross/net margins as accelerating.
This establishes that the memory thesis and company improvement were already visible before 2026, so Jan/Feb 2026 must be treated as continuation/incremental-reset rather than a brand-new theme.

The company disclosed strong volume growth but headline profit quality remained mixed.

documents.title: 中远海能2025年三季度报告点评
normalizedClaims: The contemporaneous report linked September VLCC rate strength to Q4 earnings expectations and forecast 2026 attributable profit above 2025.
